title: Encoded Regular Unique Games Family
statement: For a natural number $q$, an encoded regular Unique Games family consists of a type of semantic instances, a binary encoding of those instances, and an assignment of a regular Unique Games instance with alphabet size $q$ to each semantic instance. It also specifies, for each semantic instance, a decidable equality relation on the vertices of its associated game.
